trips.title: Spiti Valley Expedition
trips.description: Journey through the rugged landscapes of Spiti Valley. Drive along the Indo-Tibetan highway, visit ancient monasteries, and camp under the starry sky at Chandratal Lake.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shimla & Drive to Narkanda
itinerary.description: Meet your group and start the beautiful drive through pine forests.

itinerary.title: Narkanda to Chitkul/Sangla
itinerary.description: Drive to the last Indian village before the Tibet border, breathing in the fresh mountain air.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Kalpa
itinerary.description: Witness the majestic Kinnaur Kailash range from the beautiful village of Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Kaza
itinerary.description: Cross into the barren landscapes of Spiti, visiting the Nako Lake and Tabo Monastery en route.

itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Key Monastery, the high-altitude villages of Kibber, Hikkim (highest post office), and Komic.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal
itinerary.description: Drive over the mighty Kunzum Pass and camp near the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali
itinerary.description: Off-roading experience over the Rohtang Pass down into the lush Kullu Valley.

itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.description: Trip ends with a lifetime of memories.

trips.title: Leh Ladakh Expedition
trips.description: Experience the ultimate road trip to the Land of High Passes. Marvel at the changing colors of Pangong Tso, ride camels in Nubra Valley, and conquer Khardung La.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.description: Acclimatize to the high altitude. Visit Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace in the evening.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
itinerary.description: Drive over Khardung La, one of the highest motorable roads. Enjoy the sand dunes in Hunder.

itinerary.title: Turtuk Excursion
itinerary.description: Day trip to the breathtaking Turtuk village near the LoC, experiencing Balti culture.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Drive alongside the Shyok river to reach the magnificent blue waters of Pangong Lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh
itinerary.description: Wake up to a beautiful sunrise at the lake, then drive back to Leh via Chang La.

itinerary.title: Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Magnetic Hill, Pathar Sahib Gurudwara, and the Hall of Fame.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Fly out of Leh with incredible Himalayan memories.

trips.title: Kashmir Winter Wonderland
trips.description: Step into paradise on earth. Sail on the tranquil Dal Lake in a Shikara, experience the thrill of the Gulmarg Gondola, and wander through the scenic valleys of Pahalgam.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Check into a traditional houseboat. Evening Shikara ride on the Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Travel to the meadow of flowers. Take the famous Gondola cable car ride to Apharwat peak.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive through saffron fields and apple orchards to reach the Valley of Shepherds.

itinerary.title: Explore Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Visit the stunning Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Visit the beautiful Mughal Gardens and local markets.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the heavenly valley of Kashmir.

trips.title: Backpacking Meghalaya
trips.description: Dive into the abode of clouds. Trek to the magical living root bridges, explore the deepest caves, and boat on the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong
itinerary.description: Arrive in Guwahati and drive to the Scotland of the East. Visit Umiam Lake en route.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji
itinerary.description: Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sisters Falls, and explore the Mawsmai limestone caves.

itinerary.title: Nongriat Trek
itinerary.description: Hike down thousands of steps to witness the bio-engineering marvel of the Double Decker Living Root Bridge.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Dawki
itinerary.description: Drive to the Bangladesh border. Enjoy boating on the crystal clear waters of the Umngot River.

itinerary.title: Dawki to Shillong via Krang Suri
itinerary.description: Visit the magical blue waters of Krang Suri waterfalls before heading back to Shillong.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Guwahati for your onward journey.

trips.title: Kerala Backwaters & Hills
trips.description: A perfect blend of serene backwaters, lush tea gardens, and rich wildlife. Witness the majestic Western Ghats and cruise through the tranquil waters of Alleppey.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description: Drive through winding roads to the beautiful tea hills of Munnar. En route visit Cheeyappara Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam, and the Tea Museum.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.description: Travel to Periyar. Enjoy an elephant safari and an authentic spice plantation tour.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Board a traditional house-boat. Sail through the palm-fringed backwaters and enjoy Kerala cuisine.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Kochi for your departure flight.

trips.title: Andaman Tropical Escape
trips.description: Unwind on pristine white-sand beaches and dive into crystal clear waters. Discover the rich marine life of the Andaman Sea and the historical significance of Port Blair.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Port Blair
itinerary.description: Visit the historic Cellular Jail and attend the spectacular Light and Sound show.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island. Relax at the world-famous Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy snorkeling or scuba diving to witness vibrant coral reefs and marine life.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Take a ferry to the serene Neil Island. Watch a beautiful sunset at Laxmanpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Explore Neil Island
itinerary.description: Visit the Natural Bridge formation and the pristine Bharatpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Ferry back to the capital. Spend the evening shopping for souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leave with a sun-kissed glow and beautiful memories.

trips.title: Bali Essence Escape
trips.description: A romantic getaway to the island of gods. Pristine beaches and vibrant culture.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Ubud Arrival
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali.

trips.title: Thai Island Perfection
trips.description: Explore the stunning limestone cliffs and crystal clear waters of Thailand.

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Phuket Check-in
itinerary.description: Patong beach evening.

trips.title: Seychelles Paradise
trips.description: Luxury island getaway featuring the most beautiful beaches in the world.

itinerary.description: Victoria city tour.
